goal: Enable SDK-owned, bounded network retries without resending execution-unknown calls or creating a retry framework.

design.components: locked official AsyncOpenAI 2.30.0, public HTTPX AsyncClient/AsyncBaseTransport and standard asyncio.timeout
retryable: pre-request ConnectError/ConnectTimeout, excluding certificate verification errors
explicit HTTP 429 rejection unless server forbids retries
terminal: read/write timeout, protocol or opaque transport failure
design.backoff: SDK owns exponential backoff, jitter and supported Retry-After; valid waiting instructions above SDK limit terminate instead of retrying earlier
design.budget: one logical reservation because permitted earlier failures do not execute inference; actual network attempts counted separately; final missing usage or execution uncertainty remains unknown
design.compatibility: optional frozen network policy selects async API and metadata; absent network keeps exact prior synchronous zero-retry profile. Reconfiguring a private input missing network adopts current defaults.

changes: Add strict network configuration to the existing private model profile and public frozen provider locator; save timeouts and retry policy through existing CLI configure/doctor.

Use public SDK/HTTPX interfaces and no custom retry loop. A tightly scoped terminal signal escapes the locked SDK's blanket Exception retry handling; sanitized HTTP errors keep actual statuses and omit private bodies.
Check frozen request identity, endpoint and current credential before each attempt, cap attempts and response bytes, and cancel asynchronous sends/reads/backoff under one original deadline.
Success messages keep dfx_network in the existing model-call receipt; existing progress supports safe attempt/retry/status counters, without a new ledger or event bus.
Add network defaults to the ignored local file while preserving original key/model/budget fields; update safe template and existing documentation owners.

Execute the existing complete two-candidate synthetic repair and zero-new-call recovery through the new SDK channel; correct an existing test's hash-order assumption by verifying the decision actually bound to the final candidate.

validation.scope: targeted offline software verification; official SDK with exact MockTransport and actual short synthetic checks, no live service or HarmonyOS

failures_retained.repair: Preserve response-error categories for encoding/byte/JSON failure and validate JSON before SDK parsing; no retries added for invalid responses.
Combine async resource contexts; scoped justifications at necessary terminal/privacy exception boundaries, no global lint suppression.

failures_retained.result: full repair ran but test assertion failed
failures_retained.repair: Decision records are sorted by hash. Replace positional expectation with final candidate decision_id binding plus reconsider_repair and actual feedback assertions.

validation.product_check: Installed dfx.cmd doctor reads private network policy locally and still reports placeholder model/key blocked; no API request sent.

sources_checked.purpose: public async client and retry options; implementation behavior additionally checked against locked installed 2.30.0 source
bound attempts and total retry time, distinguish per-attempt timeout from operation deadline and avoid shortening unsupported server delays

remaining: Actual provider model/protocol compatibility and billing remain unknown until authorized integration.
HarmonyOS execution admission remains the next P2 work package.
